dct_description_sm: Intended network of long-term aquatic monitoring sites in the Fish Creek watershed that represents the wide variety of hydrologic types and processes of the Arctic Coastal Plain. Physical, chemical, and biological data are collected. Provides framework for integrated research on number of topics, including fish movements, fish feeding, aquatic and terrestrial invertebrates, geomorphology, drainage network analysis and classification, among others. This research is focused on collecting and analyzing baseline hydrologic data for the Fish Creek watershed located in the National Petroleum Reserve Alaska (NPR-A) in coordination with on-going and future petroleum development, fish and wildlife studies, and permafrost and climate monitoring and analysis.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Environment surveillance
dct_title_s: Fish Creek Watershed Aquatic Monitoring Related to Oil and Gas Activities and Climate Change in the National Petroleum Reserve, Alaska
